 Order

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
2.
Heard Mr. Gopinath Mishra, learned Advocate appearing for the Petitioner and Mr. Arupananda Das, learned AGA for State.

3. This Writ Petition has been filed by the Petitioner with a prayer to direct the Opposite Party No.1 to make a reference to the Competent Authority for an effective adjudication for apportionment of the awarded amount.
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that till date no reference has been made even though an application has been filed on 28th August, 2024.

5. In view of the above submission, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Writ Petition is disposed of with the direction to the Opposite Party No.1 to act upon the application of the Petitioner under Annexure-5 within the prescribed period on the production of the certified copy of the order along with a copy of the Writ Petition and pass necessary order for reference in term of Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to the Authority as per law.
